mockup_description.layout: Standard desktop admin shell: left sidebar with a 'Présences' section (Tableau de bord / Appels / Absences / Justificatifs / Retards sub-items), top bar with tenant switcher, date, global search, notification bell, locale toggle.
key_elements: Filters row: Période (date range), Classe, Statut, free-text search, Réinitialiser
4 KPI cards WITH TREND DELTAS: 'En attente 18 (+4 vs hier)', 'Approuvés 42 (+8 vs hier)', 'Refusés 6 (+1 vs hier)', 'Pièces jointes reçues 32 (75% avec pièce jointe)'
Right-side 'Aperçu du jour' panel: 'À examiner aujourd'hui: 12', 'Temps de réponse moyen: 18h45 (-2h vs hier)', 'Voir le rapport complet' link
Tabs: Toutes / En attente / Approuvées / Refusées with counts
Table columns: Élève, Classe, Date d'absence, Soumis par (name+phone), Motif (tag), Pièce jointe (thumbnail), Statut d'examen, Actions ('Examiner' button + overflow menu)

what_matches: KPI cards for pending/approved/rejected counts -- real, but plain counts, no trend deltas
CSV export via the shared DataTable component -- real
Table shows student, date, reason, document link, status, actions -- real
what_differs: No date-range or class filter -- only status tab + name search
No trend deltas ('+4 vs hier') anywhere -- would need a day-over-day comparison query, nothing like this exists in the app's KPI patterns generally

No 'Aperçu du jour' side panel (today's-queue-count, average response time) -- 'average response time' specifically would need a new derived metric (reviewedAt - createdAt average), not currently computed anywhere

No admin-initiated 'Ajouter un justificatif' (admin submitting an excuse on a parent's behalf) -- current POST route technically allows school_admin as a caller already (allowedRoles includes it), just no UI button for it
Attachment shown as a plain 'Voir' link, not a real thumbnail preview (depends on real document upload -- see 08-admin-excuse-review-drawer.json)

missing_to_add.item: 'Ajouter un justificatif' button wiring the existing POST route with an admin-facing student-picker form
missing_to_add.notes: Backend already supports this (allowedRoles includes school_admin), purely a UI gap.

missing_to_add.item: Average-response-time metric (reviewedAt - createdAt, averaged over recently-reviewed excuses)
Day-over-day trend deltas on the KPI cards
missing_to_add.notes: Needs a 'yesterday's snapshot' comparison -- either a stored daily snapshot job or a live query against yesterday's date range. No such pattern exists elsewhere in this app yet.
